question: What’s the heading toward the nearest zoo starting from Medicine Park Aquarium & Natural Sciences Center, Medicine Park, OK?
sql:
SELECT *, degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-98.508333 34.72743)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) AS angle  FROM pois
WHERE tourism = 'zoo'
ORDER BY geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-98.508333 34.72743)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Medicine Park Aquarium & Natural Sciences Center, Medicine Park, OK

poi.poi_name: Medicine Park Aquarium & Natural Sciences Center
